claims.text: Based on the evidence provided, OpenAI released GPT-5 in August 2025 as a deliberate strategic shift to consolidate its approach around a single unified model and aggressive distribution.

claims.text:
The release changed how the company sells its models through several key mechanisms:

*   **Unified Model Architecture:** OpenAI retired separate o-series products (o3, o4-mini, o3-mini, and o3-pro) by folding them into GPT-5’s internal reasoning modes [Source: ev-1].
